action: NpcRespond(identity:PlanningIdentity, intent:NpcIntent), no arbitrary answer/operation fields
contract: Recognize bound action in actual perform_native NPC dispatch
Re-observe current client receipt and use approved npc_intent_matches before any request
Emit only same-owner current NEXT or exact received-index CHOOSE via existing controller encoders
Use qualified observation clock/request state without an extra unvalidated clock or receive refresh between binding check and local controller request
Stale identity/epoch/map/open/prompt/stage/option or readiness loss sends nothing; once-only waiting stage enforces duplicate rejection
Unknown/malformed/close/name/free-text intents denied; legacy unbound Next/Select/Close/Name behavior preserved
Sending is only a request; no progress/reward inferred

first_red.cause: Actual dispatcher routes proposed typed bound response to unsupported-action rejection
first_red.prototype: Scratch-only dataclass permits reached dispatcher failure before domain action exists; not production implementation

not_authorized: Host phase activation or NPC intent authorship policy
